notes.title: Patch release Touchly v0.59
notes.content:
This release solves some issues reported by you.
[list]
[*] Fixed edge sensibility not being applied at start.
[*] Fixed watch only setting not working.
[*] Fixed physics settings not working properly or saving.
[*] Made the Depth Range setting have a higher range.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Fixed edge sensibility not being applied at start.
[*] Fixed watch only setting not working.
[*] Fixed physics settings not working properly or saving.

tags.balance_change: [*] Made the Depth Range setting have a higher range.
